cohort: 400 mothers with healthy pregnancies and their newborn singletons at Alex Ekwueme Federal University Teaching Hospital, Abakaliki, Nigeria.
finding: Maternal age, weight, hip girth, waist girth at term pregnancy, and fetal sex could determine birth mode and weight.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age, relatively large waist-hip ratio, and fetal macrosomia at term pregnancy could increase the duration of the second stage of labor and the risk of male birth and developing an abnormal Apgar score.
birth_weight: Not specified, but birth weight was an outcome measured
